# falaw

> Agent-friendly Python facade over fal.ai for generating and managing AI media (images, video, audio).

- [falaw.corpus](_autosummary/falaw.corpus.html.md): Extract model records from &#96;misc/docs/falaw.md&#96;.
- [falaw.cost](_autosummary/falaw.cost.html.md): Cost estimation: ModelRecord.cost_estimate + Scene rollups.

- [falaw.errors](_autosummary/falaw.errors.html.md): Typed exceptions for falaw operations.
- [falaw.events](_autosummary/falaw.events.html.md): Structured progress events for fal calls.
- [falaw.licences](_autosummary/falaw.licences.html.md): One licence vocabulary for every falaw ledger (falaw#110).
- [falaw.liveness](_autosummary/falaw.liveness.html.md): Is a catalogued endpoint still deployed? (falaw#76)
- [falaw.llm_prices](_autosummary/falaw.llm_prices.html.md): One first-party LLM price table: what a direct Anthropic / OpenAI call costs (falaw#81).
- [falaw.llm_rates](_autosummary/falaw.llm_rates.html.md): Per-routed-model LLM rates: the data behind a &#42;ceiling&#42; quote (falaw#50, option A).
- [falaw.llm_rates_refresh](_autosummary/falaw.llm_rates_refresh.html.md): Refresh proposals for the LLM rate table, never a silent overwrite (falaw#56).
- [falaw.local](_autosummary/falaw.local.html.md): Local utilities: ffmpeg + PIL glue for stitching fal outputs.
- [falaw.operations](_autosummary/falaw.operations.html.md): Task-level verbs: stable, agent-friendly entry points.
- [falaw.operations.audio](_autosummary/falaw.operations.audio.html.md): Audio operations: text-to-speech and friends.
- [falaw.operations.avatar](_autosummary/falaw.operations.avatar.html.md): Avatar / lip-sync operations and composers.
- [falaw.operations.images](_autosummary/falaw.operations.images.html.md): Image-generation and image-manipulation operations.
- [falaw.operations.llm](_autosummary/falaw.operations.llm.html.md): LLM-driven tools: text completion, screenplay → Scene IR, IR editing.
- [falaw.operations.preproduction](_autosummary/falaw.operations.preproduction.html.md): Pre-production: produce reusable identity anchors for a Scene.
- [falaw.operations.render](_autosummary/falaw.operations.render.html.md): Beat / shot / scene rendering with caching.
- [falaw.operations.video](_autosummary/falaw.operations.video.html.md): Video-generation operations: text-to-video and image-to-video.
- [falaw.outcomes](_autosummary/falaw.outcomes.html.md): Per-call outcomes of running a &#96;falaw.Plan&#96; — the partial-result type.

- [falaw.pricing](_autosummary/falaw.pricing.html.md): Read fal’s pricing API into &#96;models.json&#96; cost estimates (falaw#18).
- [falaw.prune](_autosummary/falaw.prune.html.md): Capacity management for the falaw cache: see what is on disk, and reclaim it.
- [falaw.refresh](_autosummary/falaw.refresh.html.md): Refresh fal.ai docs locally with conditional GETs.
- [falaw.registry](_autosummary/falaw.registry.html.md): Tool and model registries.
- [falaw.reprice](_autosummary/falaw.reprice.html.md): Re-quote a persisted &#96;falaw.Plan&#96; at today’s rates (falaw#60).
- [falaw.results](_autosummary/falaw.results.html.md): Result wrapper: parse fal responses into typed assets, lazy download.
- [falaw.scene](_autosummary/falaw.scene.html.md): Scene IR: the editable structure that survives all the way to the pixels.
- [falaw.schema_export](_autosummary/falaw.schema_export.html.md): Export the Python SSOT as committed JSON for the TypeScript twin (&#96;ts/&#96;).
- [falaw.session](_autosummary/falaw.session.html.md): Session: optional stateful controller over a sequence of falaw operations.
- [falaw.terms](_autosummary/falaw.terms.html.md): The terms ledger: may this &#96;(model, backend)&#96; be used for &#42;this&#42; job? (falaw#16)
- [falaw.testing](_autosummary/falaw.testing.html.md): Make a suite that uses falaw genuinely offline — the fake asset transport.
- [falaw.validation](_autosummary/falaw.validation.html.md): Check a call’s arguments against the limits its catalogue record states.
